time_policy: Original73 samples138..210, PTS/time_base in inputs and predictions retained; no interpolation.
comparison_units: MediaPipe native values are predicted meters; MotionBERT native values are normalized model coordinates, NOT meters. Cross-model displacement uses dimensionless fraction of each sequence median hip-knee-ankle length. Hip-centered for local discontinuity; raw root displacement separately reported.
heading: atan2(lateral.z,lateral.x), lateral=(leftShoulder-rightShoulder)+(leftHip-rightHip); unwrapped degrees. Same camera-axis arithmetic for both models, not a calibrated physical heading or independently validated depth sign.
limitations: No ground-truth 3D, global root trajectory, camera calibration, floor or contact inference.
H36M17 has no toes/heels/palms/fingers; feet/contact and wrist twist cannot be accepted.
Temporal continuity can produce the wrong facing smoothly; compare original rear-facing169..175 source images.
Head proxy, visibility confidence and 2D bilateral correction are explicit adapter assumptions.
No targetVRM retargeting or animation export in this experiment.
